Daincube introduces TP Suit tablet-based robot teaching device

The device adds emergency-stop, enable and select controls around Windows or Android tablet applications.

Robot Newspaper ↗27 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A tablet as the teaching interface

Daincube introduced TP Suit, which turns a tablet into an industrial robot teaching interface. The concept combines a familiar display and application platform with dedicated controls. The company plans to show it publicly at Roboworld.

Dedicated physical controls

TP Suit adds an emergency-stop EMG button plus Enable and Select switches, so operation need not rely solely on a touchscreen. These support robot-control workflows, but the report does not identify a safety certification level or compatibility with every controller.

Application and integration choices

Daincube describes Windows and Android support for customer-specific applications, drawing on over 20 years in control systems. Pricing, tested tablet lists and detailed delivery schedules are not disclosed. Cell builders must verify interfaces and compatibility before deployment.
